checked_obligation: Verify that (5) yields the stated recurrence, positive integer solutions of t^2-3y^2=-2, and odd y_k for every k≥0.
reason: Multiplying by 2+√3 gives t_{k+1}=2t_k+3y_k and y_{k+1}=t_k+2y_k. Norm multiplicativity from n5 preserves norm −2, while the positive initial pair and positive recurrence coefficients preserve positivity. Since t_0 and y_0 are both odd, the recurrence gives t_{k+1}≡y_k and y_{k+1}≡t_k (mod 2), so both remain odd, in particular every y_k is odd.
